name: trade-bot-hyperliquid-perp
description: Decides a Hyperliquid perpetual from a market name, candle interval, candle count, and one technical-analysis type. Analysis types: trend_structure, elliott_waves, key_levels, key_level_fibonacci, divergence, range_volatility, bollinger_bands, donchian_breakout, supertrend, ichimoku, z_score, moving_averages, chart_patterns, momentum, candlestick_patterns. Intervals: 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, 12h, 1d, 3d, 1w, 1M. A contract address is rejected, and the name does not have to be a saved asset. A clear idea returns an unsigned open or close payload. The same direction or no clear idea does nothing. A failed momentum or candlestick confirmation blocks an open and still allows a close. Dry-run and backtest do not use real USDC.
